capabilities: Chat with the current note, a selection or attachments
Inspect sources, citations and outgoing context before sending
Fork conversations from a completed answer
Manage vault memory locally or with AI extraction
Generate a local Base and Markdown article catalog
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.7+); mobile is not supported. The interface is primarily Chinese, with no English interface yet. The plugin is free and open source, but cloud AI and search providers may charge separately. Obsidian currently labels the entry as not manually reviewed by its staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to ask questions about your notes through a local DeepSeek runtime and see which note passages and tools produced the answer.

relations.evidence: powered by a locally installed DeepSeek Harness (DSH) runtime
The README organization takes inspiration from dsh-TUI
sidebar interaction design draws inspiration from Claudian

requires.name: Model provider credentials configured in DSH

summary: Desktop AI assistant that chats with notes through a locally installed DeepSeek Harness runtime, with citations, conversation forks, vault memory and manual inline completion.
